name: cobol-procedure-division-model-limits
body: parse_procedure_division diagnoses and drops statements before the first paragraph, parses then drops a declarative USE sentence, records no ALTER operands (neither as refs nor as transfers), keeps no IF/EVALUATE branch structure, and excludes one shared closed set of COBOL-85 phrase and operand keywords plus the word after FUNCTION from statement refs. Limit: ALTER targets and USE file references are lost, and a non-standard program using one of the shared keywords as a data name loses that reference. Upgrade when facts need ALTER or USE targets, or per-verb keyword sets.
